review_description: The quotes were thorough and inclusive.The installation was quick and professional with pleasant personnelSpent nearly an extra day trying to resolved a glitch with the monitoring probably due to the latest inverter model.Evaluating whether to expand current set up to gain parity with the energy supplier.Would recommend installer and hardware brands supplied.

These guys are a well sorted team. Knowledge, skills and experience ..They did what they said they would, came when arranged and they worked in with what I wanted which is fantastic when you have done your research. They obtained a top level alternative for my 1st choice of panel when it wasn't easily available which also worked as well with the Enphase Microinverters I wanted. The inspection Tech said "you have a top performing install" and the Team that did your works are a great outfit. ..I also know they recently did a +250kW (kilowatts - Yes, 500+ panels) install on a local business. I had also done a lot of research about what I wanted beforehand so it helps to be aware.

Absolutely thrilled with the prompt and reliable service from these guys. Extremely professional. No fuss and first grade work. I thoroughly recommend to anyone installing solar in Hobart. Far exceeded my expectations.

Jonathan was great to deal with. Tailored his quote to what I wanted and gave me a range of options. Installation was done in a day and is exceptional neat. Passed inspection and is performing well. Highly recommended.

From our first contact it was a pleasure to deal with Jonathan Clack. Has installed a solar system second to none. Exceeded our expectations and does everything and more in giving the best system available at reasonable costs. I wished Jonathan could have installed my system (I live in NSW, Jonathan installed a system in Tasmania for my parents) he and his team are Solar Craftsman! Keep it up Jonathan! Fantastic service! We are very happy with Solar Quotes portal putting us in contact with this professional! Thank you!

The installers were very safety conscious and postponed operations due to rain and wind but I was pleased about that as my roof is steep and slippery when wet.  The system is yet to be connected by Hydro but ready to go so cannot comment on quality, etc.  Thank you Fin for helping me find quotes and all were very professional and helpful.   I chose this one because a relative had recently used them and were very pleased.   It was not easy to decide as they were all excellent.Regards,Els
